dedupe_keys.name: mimigive climate damage integrated assessment model

description: MimiGIVE.jl is a Julia implementation of the GIVE integrated assessment model published by Resources for the Future collaborators. It uses the Mimi framework to link socioeconomic paths, emissions, climate response and damage components, with scripts for fully coupled and component-level analyses. Users choose scenarios and model assumptions; outputs include emissions, temperature and social-cost or damage indicators over time. Geographic coverage is global with region or country distinctions defined by model inputs, not individual infrastructure assets. MIT source, Julia package installation and worked access to model outputs are public. A limitation is that aggregate climate-damage estimates cannot establish local flood depths or asset fragility; uncertainty in socioeconomic paths carries through to results. MimiGIVE can provide broad climate-economic context for long-run infrastructure adaptation analysis. The related catalogue IPCC AR6 scenarios database is a separate published pathway source. No socioeconomic data, Julia package or model output was downloaded.
